title: Hard-bound design: coalesced/transposed resident source layout for top768 warp compute

why_needed.raw_layout_result: Correct but rejected: fixed-text warp compare sample bandwidth was only 74.590 GiB/s overall, projecting raw kernel time to about 1.82 s.
why_needed.required: Practical source bandwidth target is about 400-550 GiB/s after reserving time for H2D, D2H, launch/sync, and scatter/compare.
why_needed.hypothesis: The raw row-major expert layout causes poorly coalesced source loads for adjacent output columns. A block-major/output-contiguous layout may allow half-warps/warps to load neighboring MXFP4 blocks coalesced while preserving exact block bytes and arithmetic order.

hard_budget.workspace_target_mib: <=64 additional transient MiB preferred, <=128 MiB absolute diagnostic ceiling

payload_and_bandwidth.interpretation: A transposed kernel probably needs >=600 GiB/s effective source bandwidth to leave enough time for H2D/D2H/launch/sync and still fit 446.414 ms with margin.

layout_design.final_pool_size: same as raw top768 direct pool, 3264 MiB; do not store raw and transposed full copies simultaneously
layout_design.logical_layout: For each expert, store MXFP4 blocks grouped by K block or K block-pair, with output columns contiguous inside each group. Up keeps ne01=2048, ne00=4096; down keeps ne01=4096, ne00=2048.
layout_design.byte_exactness: The transform only reorders existing block_mxfp4 bytes. It must not dequantize, requantize, compress, or modify e/qs bytes.
layout_design.kernel_mapping: Reuse the half-warp CPU-compatible accumulation mapping, but load x[ib,col] from the coalesced block-major layout so adjacent half-warps/warps read contiguous source addresses.
layout_design.fallback_rule: Missing, unready, or transform-failed entries must remain on exact CPU fallback.

prefill_transform_options.reason: Transforming 3.1875 GiB on CPU at 40 GiB/s would cost about 80 ms before copy/coordination, already consuming the entire 78 ms async prefill margin.

A small raw staging buffer can receive each O_DIRECT expert payload, launch a GPU reorder into the final transposed pool, then reuse the staging buffer. Extra device traffic is about one read plus one write of 3.1875 GiB; at 400-800 GiB/s this is roughly 8-16 ms plus launch overhead, plausibly within the TTFT margin if overlapped.
It doubles the top768 payload to about 6.375 GiB and does not fit the current cpu_moe=41 dual-pool VRAM margin.

required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.name: transposed_prefill_timing
required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.behavior: Default-off direct hot pool mode that stores transposed bytes in the final pool and records raw read, H2D staging, GPU transform, insert counts, failures, VRAM, and cgroup stats.
required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.pass: direct inserted 768/768, failures 0, no OOM/no swap, extra service/TTFT cost over the accepted async direct diagnostic stays within the remaining 78.135 ms margin, with preferred <=50 ms extra.

required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.name: transposed_compare_smoke
required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.behavior: Default-off compare-only kernel after CPU fallback; CPU dst remains authoritative.
required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.pass: smoke compare has compare_ok for all compare_ran records, max_abs=0, diff_count=0.

required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.name: transposed_compare512_fixed_text
required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.behavior: Fixed-text llama-results compare with top1 check.
required_diagnostics_before_any_skip.pass: same_top1=145/145, first_mismatch_pos=-1, op-level max_abs=0, no OOM/no swap, projected raw kernel <=250 ms and projected total <=446.414 ms.

rejection_rules: Reject if transposed prefill/transform consumes the 78.135 ms TTFT margin or needs full duplicate raw+transposed VRAM.
Reject if any byte-exact compare has max_abs != 0.
Reject if projected raw kernel remains above 250 ms.
Reject if combined H2D + kernel + D2H + launch/sync + scatter/compare cannot fit 446.414 ms with margin.
Reject and close cpu_moe=41 + top768 if this coalesced layout fails, because raw scalar, raw warp, CPU batch, source-only overlap, and exact raw residency have already been closed.

decision.allowed_scope: default-off transposed-pool prefill timing and compare diagnostics only
